explication: SpotiFlyer is a multiplatform music-link lookup and downloader for tracks, albums, and playlists. The user-facing flow enters the shared root, where main, list, and preference features are exposed; provider lookup resolves links, and platform download handling saves media. The README documents support for Spotify, YouTube, YouTube Music, Gaana, JioSaavn, and SoundCloud. Several implementation paths are represented from the tree and README rather than sampled source, so their connections are marked unverified or omitted.
